canvas.title: An infinite canvas built for real company work.
canvas.subtitle: Orchestrate blocks, board frames, and living documents on a spatial plane — not another linear doc.
canvas.body: Infinite canvas replaces rigid pages with a freeform workspace. Drop text, databases, kanban, timelines, and assets onto one surface, then connect them so context stays visible while teams move.

sync.title: Cursors and co-edit on the same WebSocket.
sync.subtitle: Peers see each other move — and optionally share the same Yjs document — without Presence channel storms.
sync.body: Live collaboration rides FastAPI /ws/canvas/{room_id}. Cursors are always light; block and page co-edit uses Yjs over the same socket when LIVE is on. Project JSON still autosaves to PostgreSQL JSONB in the background.

rbac.title: Cookies, BFF, and tenant ACL — not tokens in localStorage.
rbac.subtitle: HttpOnly session cookies, Next.js proxy auth, and application-level tenant checks. RLS stays as a second fence.
rbac.body: WORKSPACE OS authenticates through /api/session (HttpOnly cookie). Browser calls hit the Next BFF (/api/backend/*), which attaches JWTs server-side. FastAPI enforces tenant membership and roles; Postgres RLS remains defense-in-depth.

0.title: Sign in once
0.desc: Session lands in an HttpOnly cookie via /api/session — never localStorage.

1.title: Same-origin BFF
1.desc: Browser calls /api/backend/*; Next attaches Authorization before FastAPI.

2.title: Tenant gates
2.desc: API checks membership and roles; RLS backs up isolation in Postgres.

0.title: HttpOnly sessions
0.desc: Access tokens never live in localStorage on the marketing or app surface.

1.title: BFF proxy
1.desc: Next attaches Authorization before FastAPI — the browser talks same-origin.

2.title: Tenant ACL + RLS
2.desc: App logic gates records and members; database policies backstop isolation.

storage.title: Board templates and protected uploads in one workspace.

storage.body: Projects can be Infinite blank canvases or dedicated boards. Uploads sit in protected Supabase storage scoped to the tenant, attachable to canvas blocks without a separate asset CMS.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.disclaimer: PORTFOLIO NOTICE: This website (WORKSPACE OS) is a software engineering portfolio project created by Berke Karacan. It is not a real commercial entity, and no real commercial services are offered. The following policy is provided for demonstration purposes to showcase full-stack development capabilities.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.content: For the purpose of this demonstration, we collect standard authentication data (such as your email address when you create an account) and dummy workspace data to showcase the real-time database and canvas features. We do not process real payments or collect sensitive personal information.

2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
2.content: The information collected is used solely to demonstrate the functionality of this application. Your session data is used to provide you with a personalized dashboard experience and to test the real-time collaboration features of the spatial canvas.

3.title: 3. Data Security
3.content: Even though this is a portfolio project, we take security seriously. All user authentication is handled securely via Supabase Auth, and Row Level Security (RLS) policies are in place to ensure you can only access your own dummy workspace data.

4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
4.content: This application integrates with third-party APIs (like Resend for emails and Notion for exports) strictly for technical demonstration. We do not sell, rent, or share your testing data with any third parties for marketing purposes.

PrivacyPage.contact: If you are a recruiter or a fellow developer and have questions about this architecture, feel free to reach out via the Contact page.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.disclaimer: PORTFOLIO NOTICE: This website (WORKSPACE OS) is a software engineering portfolio project created by Berke Karacan. It is not a real commercial entity. By using this site, you acknowledge that it is for demonstration purposes only and no real services are provided.

1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
1.content: By accessing or creating an account on this demonstration platform, you agree to be bound by these portfolio terms. If you are just browsing to evaluate my code or design skills, welcome! Feel free to test the boundaries of the application.

2.title: 2. Description of Service
2.content: WORKSPACE OS is a full-stack portfolio piece demonstrating advanced architectural concepts, including real-time PostgreSQL synchronization, spatial canvas rendering, and modern authentication flows. It is provided 'as is' without any warranty.

3.title: 3. User Accounts & Dummy Data
3.content: You are welcome to create a test account to explore the dashboard. Please do not use your real passwords or upload sensitive business data. The database may be wiped periodically to maintain performance for all reviewers.

4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
4.content: The codebase, architecture, and UI/UX design of this specific application are part of Berke Karacan's portfolio. While you are welcome to inspect the public GitHub repository (if available) and learn from it, direct commercial cloning of this exact interface is discouraged.

5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
5.content: Since this is a free, non-commercial demonstration, the creator of this project shall not be held liable for any data loss, service interruptions, or other issues arising from the use of this test environment.
